strategy: precompute immutable wind, turbine and candidate-position tables
parallel fixed-index population evaluation on one persistent all-core team
two source-required GA evaluation phases with frozen-parent generation semantics
synchronous PSO update/evaluate and ordered best commit
counter-keyed random events and ordered reductions

claim_boundary: Source-backed flexible academic reproduction of the complete paper problem and six native optimizer/constraint roles; not author source, unavailable site arrays, proprietary CMST/cost model, random state or exact numerical replay.
